aboutAnEndedOrder: About an order no longer in force
aboutAnEndedOrderOn: About an order no longer in force, ended {{stopDate}}
aboutAnEndedOrderTitle: The chart records this drug only as an order no longer in force, so the finding is about what giving it again would mean — not about a medication the patient is taking now.
aiDisclaimerText: This response is AI-generated and may not be accurate. It is not a substitute for clinical judgment. Always verify against the patient's medical records.
alreadyPrescribedTitle: The patient has an active order for this drug, so this finding is about a medication already prescribed, not one being proposed. The drug shown is the substance the module matched that order to, which the order itself may name differently — a brand name, for example.
citedInTheAnswerTitle: The answer cites this finding and the module’s checks of how it was rendered found nothing, so its detail is collapsed rather than repeated. The answer may still word it differently or leave part of it out; open the detail to read the finding in full.
drugClassNoteCitation: A note about a drug class the question named — not this patient’s record.
drugReferenceCitation: Clinical reference data — not this patient’s record.
microphonePermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow microphone permissions.
misattributedCitationTitle: The module reports that this citation may not be the medication order this sentence names, so it is not offered as a link. This is a report about the citation, not a verdict on the safety finding.
modelReasoningCaveat: The model’s working notes, not the answer. Nothing here was checked against the chart, and it can state things the answer does not.
notGroundedTitle: The cited record may not support this statement — verify against the chart.
orderStopDateTitle: The date this prescription stopped being in force — not the record’s own date shown beside it.
otherMedicationFindings_one: {{count}} finding about another of this patient’s medications
otherMedicationFindings_other: {{count}} findings about other medications this patient takes
referenceMaterialCitation: Module-supplied reference material — not this patient’s record.
safetyChecksCitedInTheAnswer_other: {{count}} findings, each cited in the answer
safetyFindingCitation: The module’s own safety finding, computed from this patient’s chart — not a chart record to open.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
sourceOfFindingsTitle: The chart record the cited safety finding is based on. The answer has no marker for it, since it cites the finding; opening it goes to the record.
speechRecognitionError: Speech recognition failed. Please try again.
unstatedSeverityTitle: Rated by the reference dataset. This answer may not state the rating — it is shown here so the findings can be ranked.
utcCalendarDayTitle: The date is a calendar day in UTC, so it can be a day off the local date.
